titular: An agent's plan is written as a contract, and a verifier with no AI publishes, case by case, the gap between what was planned and what the agent did, with its failures in view.
limites: It is a simulation: it handles no real cases and decides on no one.
The interviewer runs in the console, not in the showcase: here you see the plan it drafted for demo B, reviewed and approved by a person.
It measures what the plan declared; what it did not foresee shows up as a gap, not as a verdict.
nunca: Uses real data: every case, member, physician, applicant and watchlist is synthetic.
Lets a model decide whether the agent got it right.
Denies or rejects a case without a person reviewing it.
